plan.english: A wolf saw a lamb at the stream. He said: "You drank my water!" The lamb said: "Wolf, I did not drink your water." Then the wolf seized the lamb and ate it up.

title: The She-wolf and the Yoked Dog

plan.english: A she-wolf saw a dog. The she-wolf said: "Dog, you are full, and I thirst." The dog said: "Come to my home, she-wolf. My mistress gives me nourishment. I am yoked." She said: "You are yoked. I am free. I thirst, and I am free." Then the she-wolf went away.

A wolf clothed himself in wool and went to the sheep. Then the ram saw the fangs. The ram said: "Sheep, look! That is no sheep. The wool is a garment; the fang is his own." Then the wolf became afraid and fled. The wool hides the wolf, and the fang shows him.

A bird was sitting on a rock. Then a snake came creeping to it. The bird said: "Snake, where are you creeping?" He said: "I seek you. I bring you a good word." The bird said: "You deceive me, snake." Then the bird fled, and the snake lay down on the rock.

title: The Ram and the Bird's Apple

plan.english: A bird was carrying an apple. Then a ram saw her. The ram said: "Your word is good. Speak to me." Then the bird cried out, and the apple slipped. Then the ram ate it up. The bird said: "I heard a word. Now the apple is gone."

A snake lay in the field and became cold. Then a horse found him. The snake said: "Horse, warm me. I have become cold." Then the horse warmed the snake. Then the snake stood up and said: "Now I shall kill you." "You deceive me, snake." The snake said: "I am a snake." Then the horse fled.

title: The Two Rams on the Rock

plan.english: Two rams arrived at a rock. A ram said: "Go away, ram. I go on." That ram said: "You go away. I go on." Then the two rams pushed, and both went down into the stream. Then the stream flowed on.

title: The Wolf Who Would Not Listen

plan.english: The she-wolf said: "Wolf, where are you going?" "I go to the sheep. I am great." The she-wolf said: "The dog is awake, and the shepherd stands near. Do not go, wolf!" Then the wolf did not hear the she-wolf, and went. Then the dog seized the wolf, and the wolf fled. The she-wolf said: "You did not hear me."

title: The Sheep and the Guard Dog

plan.english: The sheep said to the dog: "Dog, you guard us. The shepherd cuts off our wool." The dog said: "I guard you. My mistress gives me a wage." The sheep said: "Your wage is our wool." Then the dog was not speaking.

A bird slipped into a net. Then a beast came. The bird said: "Beast, free me. I shall give you a gift." Then the beast slit the net and freed her. Then the beast lay down. Then a man came. Then the bird saw the man and cried out. Then the beast woke and fled. The bird said: "I gave you a gift."
A snake came to a sheep. He said: "Sheep, I give you my oath. I shall not kill you." She said: "Snake, your oath is smoke. Go away! The dog is on the alert."

title: The Lamb Who Would Go Up

plan.english: A lamb was standing on a rock and saw a bird above. He said: "Bird, you go up, and I shall go up." "My wings carry me. Walk on the earth. I go in the sky." Then the lamb did not hear her, and slipped from the rock.

It was getting dark. Then a wolf stood at the door. He said: "Dog, I give you a gift. I shall go in to the sheep." The dog said: "My mistress gives me a wage, and I remember my oath. I am awake. Run away!" Then the wolf fled.

A she-wolf lay at the door of her own home. Then a ram came. She said: "Ram, come near, or I shall die." "Many steps go to your home. Nothing goes out of it. I shall not come near." Then the ram went away, and the she-wolf lay and thirsted.
Give the guest water and mead. Whoever gives a guest mead wins good fame. The guest may be a god.
Do not break your oath. Whoever breaks an oath, punishment follows him. A god hears the oath.
Two brothers are two arms. A brother protects a brother. He does not deceive him. A sister is dear to her brother.
The sun goes down, and night arrives. Night goes away, and dawn arrives. Do not be afraid in the night.
If there is smoke, there is fire. Smoke comes up from the home. Fire does not hide itself.
Water does not bore the rock by force. By long time it bores through. Learn from the stream.
A father carries his son's burden. A son carries his father's name. A good son does not deceive his father. A mother is dear to her son.
The mind goes forward, and the hand follows. May your hand not run ahead.
Cattle die, brothers die, and a man dies. Imperishable fame does not vanish. A famous name stands.
What comes from the heart reaches the heart. A good word is a gift.
A shepherd lying down feeds the wolf. A dog that is awake guards the sheep. If the dog is on the alert, the wolf does not eat the sheep.
Dawn gives wealth to the man who works. Dawn gives no wealth to the son lying in bed. It has dawned. Rise, man!
In wealth many are dear. In distress the dear one is known. Do not deceive your dear one.
A wheel goes in the sky. No one has yoked it, and no horse draws it. Which wheel is it? It is the wheel of the sun.
"Sister, what eats and does not become full? What drinks water and dies?" The sister said: "Fire eats and does not become full. It drinks water and dies."
Who creeps in the field? He seizes a bird, but he does not grasp with a hand. Guess! It is a snake.
It comes, and no one leads it. It covers the field and the home. The sun hides from it. What is it? Night.
Who gives a garment to the man and lives? The field feeds her. The shepherd guards her. A sheep.
Who sits in the field? She goes up. No one holds her in the hand. When dawn arrives, she cries out. Guess, father! The father said: "It is a bird."
When the shepherd lies down, who is awake, stranger? He is dear to the shepherd and ill-disposed to the stranger. The stranger said: "The dog is awake."
"Sister, what goes and does not leave its bed? It comes from the earth. Beasts drink it. What is it?" A stream.
It grew in spring, and it is red. The mistress gives it to the man. What is it? An apple.
Who is born of fire and goes up from the home? No one holds him in the hand. Smoke.

title: It Comes to King and Man

plan.english: It arrives at the king and at the man. A door does not hold it. No one catches sight of it. What is it? Sleep.
Grandson, what does a man give and hold? The grandson said: "A man gives a word, and holds it."
Who stands at the door? When the sun arrives, she goes away. Dawn stands at the door.
